$comment: Structural VCR v1 contract generated from tt_telemetry::vcr::VcrReceipt. Structure alone does not prove signature integrity, issuer identity, math replay, provider usage, or invoice reconciliation.
description:
A signed Verifiable Compression Receipt. Serialized as JSON (the structured `tt::vcr::receipt` log carries it); `tt verify-receipt --receipt <json>` deserializes + verifies it offline.

`signature` is a hex-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload (see [`canonical_payload`]). `verifying_key_hex` is the hex-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key the receipt was signed with, embedded so the receipt is self-identifying (the customer does NOT need to look up the key).

org_id.description: The org whose request was compressed (joins `request_logs.org_id`).

route.description: The matched route's reserved name (e.g. `catalog:openai->gpt-4o-mini`) or the user route name. Lets the customer attribute the saving to a route decision.

savings_usd.description: The ISOLATED estimated saving in USD (mirrors `content_compress_saved_est_usd`: an estimate, NOT the invoice-reconciled headline). Canonicalized to integer micros in the signed payload.

token_delta.description: The pipeline-MEASURED input-token delta: negative = tokens removed (the compression's effect). Signed so a future audit-neutral transform round-trips honestly (a positive delta would be a rejected transform → no receipt is emitted).

trace_id.description: The request's `trace_id` (joins `request_logs.trace_id` + `quality_verdicts.request_id` when RUNG 3 gold accumulates — P2c).

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the receipt was produced (informational; explicitly NOT part of any reproduction check beyond signature validity).

verifying_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 verifying (public) key the receipt was signed with. Embedded so verification needs no external key lookup.

title: TokenTrimmer compression receipt
